sourceInference: Table paste skips selected-content deletion. A UTF-16 stream is reused for multiple PaMs; ASCII options reset after each read. A later read using a single-byte charset could turn the NUL after x into #. This is consistent with the saves, not a runtime trace or a native-paste measurement.
